name: Grän
kurzbeschreibung: Sunny village by Haldensee with a natural swimming beach and the Füssener Jöchle ski area.
beschreibung:
Grän lies at an elevation of 1,138 m at the western end of the Tannheimer Tal in the district of Reutte, Außerfern – and with around 600 inhabitants, the village is one of the smallest municipalities in the region. Its location directly on the Haldensee, one of the warmest swimming lakes in Tirol, shapes the character of the village, which has preserved its village charm to this day. The neighboring village of Nesselwängle adjoins to the east, and behind it begins the Tannheimer Berge nature reserve.

The Haldensee is the centerpiece: In summer, the natural swimming beach with fine gravel and the crystal-clear water at up to 24 °C invite you to bathe, swim, and go stand-up paddleboarding. Hikers start directly from the village center on tours such as the Gampersteig-Runde or the ascent to the Krinnenalpe at 1,563 m, where dairymaids make cheese over an open fire in summer. In winter, Grän is especially popular with families – the Füssener Jöchle ski area offers 11 kilometers of pistes, manageable and without crowds, with views of the Tannheimer Tal and the surrounding peaks. 🏔️ Snowshoe hikes and winter hiking trails starting from the village are also popular.
